texts:
Tuesday's notes, team by team: Monday night's injuries in Philadelphia, two Thursday night receivers going opposite ways, and two players headed to injured reserve.

Saquon Barkley

Lamar Jackson

Matthew Golden
#FlyEaglesFly #RavensFlock #GoPackGo

Saquon Barkley tweaked the hamstring on his first carry vs DAL Monday, then hurt his back and sat the fourth quarter. He says neither keeps him out Sunday night vs WAS.

RB12 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles injury report.
#FlyEaglesFly #DallasCowboys

Dameon Pierce led Philadelphia with 14 carries for 47 and a TD Monday, then left with 8:38 to go with an undisclosed injury.

With three Eagles backs on IR, Pierce is the only healthy handcuff. RB91 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles report.
#FlyEaglesFly

Lamar Jackson is expected to play Sunday at Buffalo after three straight missed games with the high ankle sprain, per Ian Rapoport, who said he is close to 100 percent.

QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Ravens practice report.
#RavensFlock #BillsMafia

Matthew Golden sat out Tuesday's walkthrough with the shoulder and foot, his second straight missed session before Thursday vs CAR. He drew 12 targets at Detroit in Week 7.

WR25 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's final Packers injury report.
#GoPackGo #KeepPounding

If Matthew Golden sits Thursday, Tucker Kraft is next in line for the targets in Green Bay.

TE5 rest of season for me. Monitor Golden on Wednesday's final Packers report.
#GoPackGo

Jalen Coker was a full participant Tuesday with the shoulder, per ESPN's Mike Kaye, a day after he was limited. Carolina plays Thursday at Green Bay.

WR33 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a downgrade on Wednesday's final report changes that.
#KeepPounding #GoPackGo

Tyrone Tracy Jr. went on injured reserve Tuesday with the hamstring he hurt at Houston, so he misses at least four games. Cam Skattebo has the backfield after the Week 8 bye.

Tracy is RB57 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the wire.
#NYGiants

Erick All Jr. went on injured reserve Tuesday with the right knee he hurt vs BAL, and a torn ACL is feared, per Ian Rapoport.

TE49 rest of season for me. Drop him.
#WhoDey #RavensFlock

Jaylen Wright left the win at the Jets with a quad injury after 8 snaps and 6 carries for 8 yards. Week 8 vs NE is open.

RB58 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Dolphins practice report.
#PhinsUp #NEPats

Ollie Gordon II played 83 percent of the snaps at the Jets and ran 25 times for 103 and a TD, his fourth straight game with a score.

RB45 rest of season for me. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB.
#PhinsUp #JetUp

Every Tuesday note is on the Pass, and Wednesday's Menu sets the Week 8 ranks.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy so the Menu lands in your feed, and repost this for your league.
